scope: n23 Vd=0.05 V Vg=0.05 V, true no-BGN, HFS off
goal: Separate equal-ni SG floating-point evaluation from BGN and SRH physics without changing production defaults.

pre_registered_hypothesis.statement: If equal-ni exponential cancellation is the sole cause of the M40 SRH-off anomaly, compensated evaluation will strongly close the SRH-off gap while leaving the SRH-on state nearly unchanged.

evidence_layers: same-state frozen edge and drain-cut replay
claim_policy: A failed hypothesis is a valid completed experiment.
M40 is reclassified if residual and terminal extraction use different equal-ni numerical paths.
No production default changes from M41 alone.
